propositions: The deprecated REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable must be removed from the resolver; only the config key [tool.rebar.llm].model, CLI override -c llm.model, and per-step workflow model override remain.
A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL env var must fail loudly with RemovedInputError in LLMConfig.from_env rather than being silently ignored, to prevent unintended cost and quality changes.
All test consumers setting REBAR_LLM_MODEL and building LLMConfig must be retargeted to [tool.rebar.llm].model, per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL, or -c llm.model override.
Deprecation registry row must be deleted from _deprecations.py and replaced with a tombstone entry using behavior='error', mirroring the REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS precedent.
All prose and operator-facing documentation naming REBAR_LLM_MODEL as live must be updated or removed; generated docs/env-vars.md must be regenerated and no longer list the variable.
